name: Arisaka Mashiro
source:
"I really respect [url=/c22768]Misaki[/url]-senpai!"

The only thing this little creature adores more than games is her senpai. A cute and lively underclassman who honestly expresses what she feels. She loves and admires Misaki, to the point where she follows her around everyday.

Favorite Food: Corn, whipped cream
Hobbies: Video games
Residence: Old town district (noodle shop Mashiro Udon)
Family: Father, [url=/c22806]mother[/url] (runs the noodle shop)
translation:
“我最尊敬[url=/c22768]美咲[/url]前辈了！”

这个小家伙除了游戏外最喜欢的就是前辈。她是可爱活泼的后辈，坦率表达自己的感受。她喜欢、仰慕美咲，每天都跟在她身边。

喜欢的食物：玉米、鲜奶油
爱好：电子游戏
居住地：旧城区（面屋“真白乌冬”）
家庭：父亲、[url=/c22806]母亲[/url]（经营面店）
